name: IELTS
summary: Coaching for both IELTS forms, across all four skills, with mock tests and a study plan built around your current level.

variants.name: Academic IELTS
variants.suitableFor: Applicants to higher education and professional registration.

variants.name: General Training IELTS
variants.suitableFor: Applicants for migration and for work or training below degree level.

modules.name: Listening
modules.focus: Question-type drills, note-taking and accent exposure.

modules.name: Reading
modules.focus: Skimming, scanning and timing strategy for each question type.

modules.name: Writing
modules.focus: Task structure, task response and corrected drafts for both tasks.

modules.name: Speaking
modules.focus: All three parts, rehearsed and reviewed with a teacher.

preparationFeatures: Practice sessions for each of the four skills
A personalised study plan based on a diagnostic test
Tips and strategies for each question type
Written feedback on your Writing tasks
scoreImprovementApproach:
We begin with a diagnostic test to find where you are losing marks, then concentrate teaching time on those question types rather than covering everything evenly. Progress is re-measured with further mock tests.

We do not promise a band score. No honest teacher can.

name: PTE
summary: PTE Academic coaching across the integrated skills, with practice and mock tests on the computer-based format.

modules.name: Speaking & Writing
modules.focus: The integrated tasks, with feedback on both delivery and structure.

modules.name: Listening
modules.focus: Note-taking and the summarising task types.

preparationFeatures: Practice tests on the computer-based format
Strategy work on the integrated task types
scoreImprovementApproach: PTE scores several tasks across more than one skill at once, so marks are often lost in a different place from where the problem is. We diagnose first and teach to that, then re-measure with mock tests. No score is promised.

name: TOEFL
fullName: Test of English as a Foreign Language
summary: TOEFL coaching across all four sections, with practice sessions and timed mock tests.

modules.name: Reading
modules.focus: Academic passage strategy and question-type drills.

modules.name: Speaking
modules.focus: Response structure and timing, rehearsed and reviewed.

modules.name: Writing
modules.focus: Essay structure and the integrated task, with corrected drafts.

preparationFeatures: Written feedback on your Writing responses

name: GRE
summary: GRE coaching across verbal reasoning, quantitative reasoning and analytical writing, with practice tests.

modules.name: Verbal Reasoning
modules.focus: Reading comprehension and text completion strategy, with vocabulary work.

modules.name: Quantitative Reasoning
modules.focus: Concept revision and problem-solving method, not formula memorisation.

modules.name: Analytical Writing
modules.focus: Argument analysis and essay structure, with corrected drafts.

preparationFeatures: A personalised study plan based on a diagnostic test

name: GMAT
summary: GMAT coaching across quantitative reasoning, verbal reasoning and data insights, with practice tests.

modules.name: Quantitative Reasoning
modules.focus: Problem-solving method and accuracy under time pressure.

modules.name: Verbal Reasoning
modules.focus: Critical reasoning and reading comprehension strategy.

modules.name: Data Insights
modules.focus: Data interpretation and sufficiency reasoning across sources.

preparationFeatures: A personalised study plan based on a diagnostic test
Error-log review after every practice test
